item.title: NATIONAL 211 DAY HIGHLIGHTS FREE 24/7 HELPLINE LINKING PEOPLE TO LOCAL RESOURCES
item.description: National 211 Day, an annual event that highlights the free, 24/7 helpline connecting people to vital resources during times of crisis, takes place on Wednesday, Feb. 11. The helpline works in all 50 states, and any local United Way helps connect people to food, housing, health and disaster resources. item.title: VICTIM IDENTIFIED IN FATAL TRANSYLVANIA COUNTY LANDFILL ACCIDENT
item.description: Warning: This article contains sensitive subject matter that some may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised. item.title: CAMPUSES DENIED EARLY VOTING SITES ON THREE NC UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES
item.description: Students at three North Carolina universities who had gone to court to get early voting sites on their campuses will likely not have any during this primary election, after a federal district court judge ruled against them on Sunday.
